summary: Hecla Mining filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01 to report Q1 2026 operating and financial results, including revenue of over $411 million and record free cash flow of $144 million from continuing operations. The filing also announced a common stock dividend of $0.00375 per share and a Series B preferred dividend of $0.875 per share, with record and payment dates specified. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 contains these results. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration filing, not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring.
